# Town of Worcester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Worcester, town Directory (live): 'CEMETERY COMMISSION / Chair: Julia Shedd / Treasurer/Secretary: Francette Cerulli' -- both corroborated acting in the commission's minutes of April 27 and July 15, 2026 (styled 'Julie' and 'Fran'). Minted elected on this presentation, disclosed on issue #163.

Town of Worcester, Cemetery Commission minutes, September 9, 2026, item 7: 'Fran moved to appoint John Meninger to the commission to fill the remainder of Heather Pagel's open position. Julie seconded. John accepted.' Pagel's cemetery membership is ended in this sweep (her separate Treasurer record is untouched). Noted on issue #163: 24 V.S.A. section 963 ordinarily vests vacancy appointments in the selectboard; the appointment here is recorded in the commission's own minutes and no selectboard minute was found.
